text: High-altitude wind streaming through thick clouds, airy and smooth, soft rushing air with slow gentle swells, calm, no howling, no gusts, no whistling
A soft airy whoosh as a camera glides down through a cloud and breaks out into clear air, smooth filtered rush that swells and fades, gentle, no impact, no hit
Distant Mumbai city ambience heard from high above: a faint far wash of traffic, very distant soft car horns, a few far birds, calm and low, no close sounds

A modern metro train passing on an elevated concrete viaduct, heard from street level a short distance away: smooth electric motor whine rising and falling, soft steady rail rhythm, gentle doppler pass from left to right, no horn, no announcements
A single soft subtle user-interface tick, clean, very short, quiet, premium software tap, no reverb
A soft digital counter roll: a quick run of tiny quiet ticks like an odometer rolling up and settling on a number, clean and premium, ends with one soft final tick
A gentle cinematic riser: a soft airy swell with a faint shimmer that rises smoothly for four seconds into a transition, warm and subtle, no hit at the end, no impact
A soft cinematic impact for a logo reveal: a warm low deep thud with a gentle bloom, followed by a delicate bright shimmer that sparkles and fades away, elegant and premium, not aggressive
Evening traffic ambience in Mumbai heard from a little distance: a steady soft flow of cars and auto-rickshaws, occasional distant horns, warm and calm, no close voices
A single crisp delicate user-interface tick, high and glassy, very short and quiet, like a premium watch click, clean, no reverb
